limitations: Death/abandon weapon charges have exact total asset loss but consumption-versus-lost-residual split is unknown without a final inventory snapshot.
No asset is assigned an invented kindling sale price; heterogeneous tools and facility HP cannot be added into cash.
Exact owned stocks and maturity are accounting evidence, not proof that abilities created useful action windows.
Shared ancestors/fixed-world branches are not independent players or estimates of long-term expected grade value.
Per-field and operator wall time are distinct; pure human preparation, listening, fatigue and all-world balance remain unverified.
